messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a short change window tonight 02:00 UTC to roll runtime -> v2.4. Need to pin console and router for the window to avoid header/schema drift. Release notes: https://go.redwood/release/runtime-2.4 :link:

deploy-bot: Change window scheduled by alex for 02:00 UTC (window id cw-1758256789). Planned actions: runtime v2.4 rollout (canary -> 25% -> 100%), console pinned to 1.5, router pin request submitted. Runbook link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/runtime-2.4

meera: Quick question — runtime v2.4 changes the routing header encoding (x-rd-kv -> x-rd-kv-v2). If router isn't pinned we could see routing misrouted sessions. Ryan, can ops confirm router will be pinned and config toggle is ready?

ryan: Ops confirms router pin to 3.2 for the change window. I'll stage the pin 15m before start and hold traffic switch until console confirms UI compatibility. API (v1.9) is backward-compatible for short window. Rollback criteria proposed below.

jana: Proposed rollback criteria: (1) sustained 5xx rate >1% over baseline for 5m, (2) p95 latency >150ms for 10m, or (3) console errors >0.5% users on critical flows. If any trigger, rollback to runtime v2.3 and unpin flags. Also request a manual abort if deploybot reports schema mismatch.

alex: I'm the owner for this window. I'll be oncall and will signal rollback if thresholds hit. Ryan — please keep request logs around for at least 2h after deploy for debugging. Also can someone run a quick canary smoke before traffic shift?

ryan: Will do. Canary smoke checklist: 1) health-check endpoints (GET /health -> 200), 2) KV header roundtrip test, 3) sample chat generation smoke. I'll paste the smoke curl in the runbook:

```bash
# KV header roundtrip
curl -s -H "x-rd-kv: test-123" https://staging-runtime.redwood/v1/echo | jq .headers
```

deploy-bot: Will post wave updates during rollout. Notifying related channels: #runtime, #console, #router. If rollback happens I'll attach deploy logs. Good luck :rocket:

meera: FYI I'll watch the console error rate and check UI mapping for the header name. If I see any mismatch I'll call abort immediately.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release notes thread shortly after the window with final postmortem if anything unusual occurs. :thumbsup:
